# Atomic Physics {.unnumbered}

Explore the development of atomic physics, the foundations of quantum mechanics, and the structure of atoms and their interaction with external fields.

## How we learn

We meet twice a week, with two 45-minute periods per meeting. Prepare before class, work through questions together during class, and consolidate your understanding afterward.

Materials will be added as the course develops.
